title: Add clawsub version --json flag
prompt: Add a --json flag to `clawsub version` that outputs {version, node} as JSON instead of the human-readable string. Update the help text. Add a unit test.
acceptanceCriteria: clawsub version --json outputs valid JSON with 'version' and 'node' keys
clawsub version (no flag) still outputs the human-readable version string
help text includes --json in the version command signature
unit test covers both --json and plain output
